correctness.rationale: The commutator map has image the sum of matrices with columns in im(X) and rows in row(Y), dimensions cr and as and intersection rs. The centralizer index is q^(cr+as-rs). For rank(X)=r, rank(Y)=s, the condition rank(XY)=k is dim(imY cap kerX)=s-k. Gaussian choices of the intersection, quotient projection, graph, and surjections give exactly the displayed coefficient. The far-off-diagonal block is arbitrary. For b>=a, conditioning on X having full row rank yields t=ac and uniform XY with total variation error bounded by its complement probability. The verification program independently constructs commutator-map ranks and checks all (t,k) coefficients in eleven cases, including 531441 group elements in one case. Finite checks are corroboration, not universal proof.

originality.rationale: The new theorem fixes arbitrary positive 3-block dimensions and determines all simultaneous (conjugacy-class size, rank of squared nilpotent part) multiplicities, and class counts, together with a fixed-end limiting law. Hennecart–Perry 2022 sum commutator-centralizer fibers for total commuting pairs; Goodwin–Röhrle 2009 handle total polynomial class counts and parabolic-orbit centralizers; Diaconis–Malliaris 2021 cover standard Heisenberg special cases. These stronger-in-other-directions results do not state or logically determine the joint law merely from their published aggregate numerical invariants. Local indexed findings on 3-block commuting probabilities, four-block class spectra and UT3 element orders were compared. Residual risk from unlocated equivalent incidence identities remains.
residual_risks: An equivalent formula for ranks of products of rectangular random matrices may exist under independent finite-geometry terminology.
A general parabolic orbit class parametrization might imply the new table after nontrivial summations that were not performed in the inspected sources.
The 2019 quiver and upper-triangular works were inspected only in introductory material, not exhaustively.
Searches including published-finding corpus rankings cannot establish uniqueness or exhaustive publication priority.

value.rationale: A natural complete conjugacy-class-size profile is refined by the nilpotence invariant rank((g-I)^2) for all positive three-block sizes and all finite fields. At q=2 with 2x2x2 blocks, a single class-size stratum has three square ranks, distinguishing involutions from order-four elements of equal class size. The nondegenerate limit for square rank, alongside class-size concentration, makes this a substantive structural separation rather than an arbitrary finite subcase.
